name: Shadowhide Claw's infusion makes abilities deal Shadowhide Strike damage (#10585)
contract: Using Shadowhide Claw (item 450572) applies Shadowhide Infusion (303084), a SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL aura that triggers Shadowhide Strike (303085, Shadow school damage). Its tooltip reads: coats your weapons in shadows, causing your abilities to deal $303085m1 + 10% of spell power + 10% of attack power additional Shadow damage for 15 sec.
The aura's DBC record carries ProcFlags 0, and the world had no spell_proc row and no spell_bonus_data row, so the buff applied but never dealt damage and never showed on a damage meter, as reported.

Expected: while the infusion is up, every landed damaging ability (melee, ranged, none or magic damage class) triggers Shadowhide Strike at the DBC ProcChance of 100%; auto attacks are not abilities and periodic ticks are not ability hits.

The strike's done bonus rises by one tenth of added attack power and one tenth of added spell power. Level-27 Rangers (the trinket's item level, where the spell level penalty of this rank-22 spell is 1) with +1000 attack power and with +1000 spell power are compared with an identical plain player. Ascension's per-class damage tuning scales every done bonus, so each difference is divided by the same player's done amount for the coefficient-free sibling Shadowhide Strike 312916 (same school, damage class and family, no spell_bonus_data): the expected quotient is 100 / 1000 = 0.1. Before the repair the differences are 0.
End to end, a Ranger's Whipvine Arrow (ranged damage class) at a dummy while infused deals Shadowhide Strike damage to that dummy; a player who never used the trinket deals none.
